sources.name: Tailte Éireann / CSO Small Areas
sources.dataset: CSO Small Areas - National Statistical Boundaries - 2022 - Ungeneralised; 640 Tipperary features
sources.notes: Raw ArcGIS query is pinned in the source manifest. Query requests outSR=4326. 640 valid, unique Tipperary Small Area features; geography vintage is 2022. Source update date is not published in the captured metadata and remains null. Raw checksum and byte count are in backend/data/processed/source_manifest.json.

sources.name: CSO Census 2022 Small Area Population Statistics
sources.dataset: SAPS Small Area Urban/Rural CSV; population, age 65+ and household car availability
sources.notes: Joined to Census 2022 boundary public IDs; 640/640 Tipperary Small Areas matched. Age counts are persons; no-car counts are households. The age-65+/no-car person intersection is not published here; normalized target_cohort_residents is null and cohort_method is unknown. Raw checksum and byte count are in backend/data/processed/source_manifest.json.

sources.name: NTA GTFS
sources.dataset: NTA/TFI GTFS_All static feed; countywide stop subset exported
sources.notes: Feed acquired; all six required tables structurally validated: 14,155 stops, 805 routes, 267,335 trips, 8,438,017 stop_times, 289 calendar rows and 1,927 calendar_dates rows; no detected identifier/format errors. Feed service-date bounds recorded as 2026-10-02 through 2027-10-03. All 286 county GTFS stops matched active NaPTAN ATCO codes. This does not validate chronological/transfer feasibility or calculate a journey graph; those remain with B. Raw checksum and byte count are in backend/data/processed/source_manifest.json.

sources.name: Healthcare and essential services, including OSM where appropriate
sources.dataset: Healthcare service locations not yet ingested; CSO MDSI01 GP distance baseline ingested separately
sources.notes: No source-backed healthcare location records or opening hours ingested. A mapped facility does not establish opening hours, appointments or capacity. CSO 2026 GP-distance baseline is in source cso-health-distance-2026.

sources.name: CSO Measuring Distance to Services in Ireland 2026 - Health Services
sources.dataset: MDSI01 GP person and dwelling median distance by Small Area GUID
sources.notes: All 640 Small Areas joined by the 2022 boundary SA_GUID. Distances are CSO-published GP distance measures, not timetable-based journey times. Source update date left null because it was not verified in downloaded metadata. Checksum and acquisition time are in backend/data/processed/source_manifest.json.

sources.name: Pobal deprivation
sources.dataset: Pobal HP Deprivation Index 2022; Electoral Division geography
sources.notes: All 640 Small Areas matched through their official Electoral Division code. Pobal measure remains ED-level contextual data and is not represented as a Small Area score. Raw checksum and byte count are in backend/data/processed/source_manifest.json.

sources.notes: No alert feed or closure extent ingested. Current road disruption is a frontend synthetic fixture.

sources.name: OPW flooding

sources.notes: No flood dataset ingested. Hazard maps are not live event observations; current flood scenario is synthetic.

sources.name: NTA NaPTAN Stop Points
sources.dataset: Active Tipperary stop points from the official Irish stop feed
sources.notes: Irish coverage confirmed from official TFI download. 374 active Tipperary stops; coordinates exported as WGS84 points, preserving ATCO IDs and source status/update fields. Raw checksum and byte count are in backend/data/processed/source_manifest.json.
